Mina / Anika — thanks for sending. A few notes from Finance:

- Our default payment term for newly onboarded suppliers is Net 45 while the vendor completes a 90-day payment history and verification cycle. After the cycle we standardize to the negotiated term (commonly Net 30/45/60 depending on contract).

- We do run an early-pay program (Treasury-led) that supports vendor discounts (e.g., 2% 10 Net 30 or similar). Eligibility is evaluated case-by-case and requires:
  * Completed vendor onboarding packet (we have the W9 + ACH form — thanks)
  * Vendor created in our AP system with validated bank details
  * Signed payment terms addendum (DocuSign link below)
  * Approval from Finance Director for first 90 days exceptions

- For ByteForge specifically, finance is open to 1.5% 10 Net 30 but we’d have to set the vendor to a provisional status (Net 45 default) and approve an early-pay exception that will be evaluated for month-end settlement. If approved, Treasury will schedule accelerated runs and we'll tack the discount to the remittance.

Actions for Anika / ByteForge:
1) Please confirm legal name for the PO exactly (as it appears on the W9).
2) Complete the redline on the payment terms addendum: https://docu.sign/redwood/byteforge-terms (DocuSign).
3) Let us know preferred remittance instructions.

Once those are in place I will raise the exception to Finance Director; Marissa, can you attach the prospective PO so AP has a reference?

Ben Carter
Accounting Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
